description: Checks that a new BProgram starts with no registered threads or dispatched events.
testCode:
from helpers import BProgram
bp = BProgram()
assert bp.threads == [], 'A new BProgram must start with no registered b-threads'
assert bp.history == [], 'A new BProgram must start with an empty event history'

name: Functional B-Threads
description: Verifies that the hot and cold functional requirements request the correct events for the configured number of cycles.
testCode:
import main

def collect_requests(factory, event_name):
    gen = factory()
    requests = []
    selected = None
    while True:
        try:
            spec = next(gen) if selected is None else gen.send(selected)
        except StopIteration:
            break
        assert isinstance(spec, dict), 'Each b-thread must yield a synchronization dictionary'
        req = spec.get('request', [])
        requests.extend(req if isinstance(req, list) else [req])
        selected = event_name
    return requests

hot = collect_requests(main.add_hot_water, main.HOT_WATER)
cold = collect_requests(main.add_cold_water, main.COLD_WATER)
assert hot == [main.HOT_WATER] * main.FILL_CYCLES, 'add_hot_water must request HOT_WATER exactly FILL_CYCLES times'
assert cold == [main.COLD_WATER] * main.FILL_CYCLES, 'add_cold_water must request COLD_WATER exactly FILL_CYCLES times'

name: Deterministic Event Selection
description: Confirms that identical program configurations produce the same event trace.
testCode:
import main
trace_a = main.build_program().run(max_steps=50)
trace_b = main.build_program().run(max_steps=50)
assert trace_a == trace_b, f'Expected deterministic traces, got {trace_a} and {trace_b}'

name: Integrated Event Behavior
description: Checks that both functional fill events and the safety drain behavior occur in the integrated execution.
testCode:
import main
trace = main.build_program().run(max_steps=50)
assert trace.count(main.HOT_WATER) == main.FILL_CYCLES, 'Integrated trace must contain all HOT_WATER requests'
assert trace.count(main.COLD_WATER) == main.FILL_CYCLES, 'Integrated trace must contain all COLD_WATER requests'
assert main.DRAIN_VALVE in trace, 'Safety behavior must request at least one DRAIN_VALVE event'

name: Tank Safety Invariant
description: Reconstructs tank volume after every dispatched event and verifies that capacity is never exceeded.
testCode:
import main
trace = main.build_program().run(max_steps=50)
volume = 0
max_seen = 0
for step, event in enumerate(trace, start=1):
    if event in (main.HOT_WATER, main.COLD_WATER):
        volume += 1
    elif event == main.DRAIN_VALVE:
        volume = max(0, volume - main.DRAIN_AMOUNT)
    max_seen = max(max_seen, volume)
    assert volume <= main.MAX_CAPACITY, f'Safety violation at step {step}: volume={volume}, MAX_CAPACITY={main.MAX_CAPACITY}'
assert max_seen == main.MAX_CAPACITY, 'The test scenario should reach the capacity boundary so the safety rule is exercised'
